published.source: Standards 11 explosives update (2026-10-23, explosives only when they gain): Goblin Land Mine dropped, Goblin Sapper Charge kept (was 880.1)

summary: Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon with a two-hand axe, and Windfury Totem for the group, with Magma Totem and the raid's Flametongue Totem on its weapon.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -6s, Windfury Totem at -5s, Mana Spring at -4s, Lightning Shield at -3s, Magma Totem at -1.5s (the totems last the whole fight but run out a few seconds before a 300s one ends)
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Magma Totem when it is down and at least 2s remain (after the pre-pull one)
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it
Other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion)
Fire Nova while Clearcasting is up
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova while the mana covers 12 a second for the rest of the fight
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs at 2 PPM per point, until the beta reaches level 34.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Strength of Earth IV, Battle Shout VI): about 7.7 DPS.
One 2% crit elixir. Mongoose, Grizzly and Owl stacked would add about 36.
Earth Shock VII's base damage is ×1.08 (client ×1.00).
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate.
Fire Nova uses the 70425 values: coefficient 0.143, rank 5 base 232 to 259.
Assumed: another shaman's Flametongue Totem works alongside the preset's own Windfury Weapon, for +18 to +19 DPS at 180s. Not yet tested in game.
Improved Stormstrike 2 in place of Tidal Focus 1 is tuned at 180 s: about -3 at 120 s for +1 to +2 at 180 s and +4 to +5 at 300 s, paired at 20000 iterations on two seed sets.
Relic: Totem of the Storm (Lightning Bolt can trigger Maelstrom Weapon at half the chance), +0.9 to +2.1 over Burning Totem at every length.
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl optimized (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totem is a second shaman's Grace of Air, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself).
